name: mpSEEJAY
author: noahsoconnor
summary: Two DJ decks for an external DJ mixer: one plugin per deck, each on its own output. Waveforms, tempo and beat-grid detection, sync, pitch fader, jog and nudge, cue, hot cues, loops and rolls, a track browser, and the 16 pads mirrored on screen and lit on the MPC. WAV and MP3. Tested on an MPC Live II, MPC OS 3.10.1.
